findings: The intake describes a generic causal isolation-forest OR autoencoder representation, predictive anomaly score, rolling three-sigma threshold and NAB evaluation; it does not identify a winning detector implementation.
The cited NAB repository supplies benchmark tooling and multiple detector implementations; its existence does not establish that the intake recipe is a historical high-tier result.
Pinned selected software and license only. Nine independent synthetic scoring cases passed; two core scoring boundary defects reproduced.
intended_scope: Complete explicitly configured causal isolation-forest branch of the generic intake plus rolling score threshold and corrected NAB evaluation. No Numenta HTM or scoreboard-equivalent claim.
next_steps: Implement current-point exclusion from representation fitting and threshold statistics with explicit warmup, fit history, model seed and window controls.
Define source boundary corrections for low thresholds and singleton windows; retain ordinary-case NAB score parity and validate probation, multiple windows and normalization.
Validate prefix invariance, full synthetic graph execution, source-scope review and Tier 3 publication gates before any catalog approval.
